title: On Weighted Convex Graphs
summary: The main objective of this paper is to develop Krein-Milman-type theorems and Ulam-type stability results for graphs. To establish these results, we introduce several meaningful definitions of vertex-weighted convex graphs inspired by the concept of sequential convexity. We also present a close relationship between the two discrete structures, namely sequential convexity and perfect binary trees. We show that if a graph satisfies a certain convexity property approximately, then this property can be made exact by minimally perturbing the weights assigned to its vertices.
